description: Dashboard for monitoring the Low Rate Reactors (LRR) as part of the BPA project

targets.query:
import "strings"

from(bucket: "reactor-monitoring")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "pico_measurements")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["device"] =~ /^pico_[1-4]$/) // Matches pico_1, pico_2, pico_3, pico_4
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "pH")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      _value: r._value,
      _field: "Reactor " + strings.substring(v: r.device, start: 5, end: 6) + " pH", // Labels as "Pico 1 pH"

  }))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "picos")

import "strings"

from(bucket: "reactor-monitoring")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] =~ /^gas_meter_[1-4]$/) 
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "Flow Normalised (mL/min)")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) // Smooths based on the dashboard time window
  |> movingAverage(n: 10) 
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      _value: r._value,
      _field: "Gas Meter " + strings.substring(v: r._measurement, start: 10, end: 11) + " - Flow Normalised (mL/min)"
  }))
  |> yield(name: "gas_meters")

import "strings"

from(bucket: "reactor-monitoring")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] =~ /^gas_meter_[1-4]$/) // Matches gas_meter_1 to gas_meter_4
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "Volume (mL)") // Direct match instead of contains()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 30m, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) // Ensures data every 10 min
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      _value: r._value,
      _field: "Gas Meter " + strings.substring(v: r._measurement, start: 10, end: 11) + " - " + r._field,
      meter: r._measurement  // Retain meter identifier for Grafana filtering
  }))
  |> yield(name: "gas_meters")
